text_block_list.text:
While discussing the training menu with Hishi Amazon,
something caught my attention...
choice_data_list: What happened to your tail today?
What's up with your tail today?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? Oh, this?
It's just bedhead, bedhead.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I went to bed yesterday without really drying it off, you see.
Even the underclassmen at the dorm gave me an earful for it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well... some days are just like that. More importantly—

Hishi Amazon looks terribly sleepy.
Could fatigue be catching up with her?
Maybe I should review her upcoming race schedule.
